name: Practice Test 5 · Vocabulary
subtitle: Words & options from Module 1 and Module 2

words.defn_en: a mark, object, or sign showing the existence or passing of something

sentences.en: After the thieves fled the museum, police officers searched every corner but could not find any ______ of their entry.
sentences.zh: 竊賊逃離博物館後，警官搜尋了每個角落，但找不到任何他們進入的「痕跡」。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true

sentences.en: The prosecutor presented convincing physical ______ during the trial, proving beyond doubt that the suspect was guilty.
sentences.zh: 檢察官在審判期間出示了令人信服的實物「證據」，無可置疑地證明了嫌犯有罪。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: a small mark or flaw that spoils the appearance of something

sentences.en: Despite a minor paint ______ on the passenger door, the vintage sports car was in otherwise flawless condition.
sentences.zh: 儘管乘客車門上有微小的烤漆「瑕疵」，這輛復古跑車在其他方面狀況完好無阻。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: a quantity of something, especially total sum or value

sentences.en: Environmental scientists measured a large ______ of microplastics in the river water following the storm.
sentences.zh: 環境科學家在暴風雨後測量到河水中含有大量的微塑膠「數量」。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: a rough or unfinished drawing or outline

sentences.en: The architect drew a quick preliminary ______ on a napkin to explain her innovative concept to the client.
sentences.zh: 建築師在餐巾紙上畫了一張快速的初步「草圖」，向客戶解釋她的創新概念。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: easy to identify or know from previous experience

sentences.en: With its distinct yellow taxicabs and skyscrapers, New York City remains instantly ______ to people worldwide.
sentences.zh: 憑藉其獨特的黃色計程車和摩天大樓，紐約市對全世界的人來說依然能被瞬間「辨認（識別）」。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: easily broken, damaged, or delicate

sentences.en: Movers packed the antique crystal glasses in thick bubble wrap to protect the ______ items during transport.
sentences.zh: 搬家工人用厚氣泡紙包裹古董水晶杯，以在運輸過程中保護這些「易碎的」物品。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: occurring or found frequently; widespread

sentences.en: Seasonal allergies are extremely ______ during spring, when pollen counts rise rapidly across rural areas.
sentences.zh: 季節性過敏在春天非常「常見（普遍）」，此時農村地區的花粉計數迅速上升。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: developed to a high degree of complexity and refinement

sentences.en: Modern weather forecasting relies on ______ satellite systems and supercomputers to project storm paths.
sentences.zh: 現代天氣預報依賴「先進的（精密的）」衛星系統和超級電腦來預測風暴路徑。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: preceding in time or order; previous

sentences.en: Historians argued that political instability in the decade ______ to the revolution made conflict inevitable.
sentences.zh: 歷史學家主張，革命「先前（前情）」數十年的政治不穩定使得衝突不可避免。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: about to happen; looming or approaching soon

sentences.en: Dark storm clouds gathered along the horizon, warning farmers of an ______ torrential downpour.
sentences.zh: 烏雲在地平線上聚集，警告農民一場「即將發生的」傾盆大雨。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: not harmful or offensive; harmless

sentences.en: Although the comment sounded harsh at first, it was intended as an ______ joke among close friends.
sentences.zh: 雖然這句話起初聽起來很刺耳，但它本意是好朋友之間一個「無害的」玩笑。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: never ending or changing; continuous

sentences.en: Located near the North Pole, the region experiences ______ darkness during the freezing winter months.
sentences.zh: 該地區位於北極附近，在寒冷的冬季月份經歷著「長期的（持續不斷的）」黑暗。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to put forward an explanation as a starting point for investigation

sentences.en: Biologists ______ that warmer ocean temperatures are causing coral reefs to bleach at an unprecedented rate.
sentences.zh: 生物學家「推測（假設）」，較暖的海洋溫度正在導致珊瑚礁以前所未有的速度白化。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to regard something as untrue, unlikely, or unimportant

sentences.en: Scientists should not completely ______ alternative theories until rigorous experimental data has been analyzed.
sentences.zh: 在分析嚴謹的實驗數據之前，科學家不應完全「不採信（低估）」替代理論。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to define again or differently; transform concept

sentences.en: The invention of smartphones helped to completely ______ how people communicate and access information daily.
sentences.zh: 智慧型手機的發明有助於完全「重新定義」人們日常如何溝通和獲取資訊。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to make productive use of or take advantage of a resource

sentences.en: Engineers designed geothermal power plants to ______ heat generated naturally deep beneath the Earth's crust.
sentences.zh: 工程師設計地熱發電廠，以「利用（開發）」地球地殼深處自然產生的熱能。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to give official permission or approval for an action

sentences.en: The city council voted unanimously to ______ the construction of a new public park in the downtown area.
sentences.zh: 市議會一致投票「批准（認可）」在市中心區域興建一座新的市立公園。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to make a bad or difficult situation better; improve

sentences.en: The government introduced targeted subsidies to ______ economic hardship among low-income households.
sentences.zh: 政府實施了有針對性的補助，以「改善」低收入家庭的經濟困境。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to attempt to explain or justify behavior with logical reasons

sentences.en: Instead of admitting his obvious mistake, the manager tried to ______ his poor decision with statistical excuses.
sentences.zh: 經理沒有承認他明顯的錯誤，而是試圖用統計數據上的藉口來為他的不良決定「合理化（辯解）」。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to suggest or assume the existence of something as a basis for reasoning

sentences.en: Astrophysicists ______ that dark matter makes up a significant portion of the total mass in the universe.
sentences.zh: 天體物理學家「假定（推測）」，暗物質佔據了宇宙總質量的大部分。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to extend one's hand or body toward something or someone

sentences.en: During dinner, she had to ______ ______ ______ the far end of the long table to grab the salt shaker.
sentences.zh: 晚餐時，她不得不「把手伸向」長桌遠端去拿鹽罐。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to unite or connect with another group or person

sentences.en: Local community leaders decided to ______ ______ regional environmental activists to protect the nearby river.
sentences.zh: 當地社區領袖決定「與...聯合」區域環境保護人士，一同保護附近的河流。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to get closer to someone or something being pursued

sentences.en: The marathon runner increased his speed during the final mile to ______ ______ the lead competitor ahead.
sentences.zh: 馬拉松跑者在最後一英里加快速度，以「逼近（趕上）」前面領先的對手。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to extend one's body or limbs in the direction of something

sentences.en: Sunflowers naturally turn and ______ ______ the sunlight as it moves across the sky during the day.
sentences.zh: 當太陽白天在空中移動時，向日葵會自然地轉動並「向...延伸（伸向）」陽光。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to reach a conclusion, decision, or place after effort

sentences.en: After hours of intense negotiation, union representatives and management were able to ______ ______ a fair agreement.
sentences.zh: 經過數小時的密集談判，工會代表和管理層終於能夠「達成」一項公平的協議。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to take up or fill a proportion of space, time, or position

sentences.en: Constructing the new highway expansion will ______ several acres of farmland adjacent to the suburban neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 興建這條新的公路擴建工程將「佔用（佔據）」鄰近郊區社區的數英畝農田。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to store up wealth or materials secretly or excessively

sentences.en: During economic crises, some individuals tend to ______ essential goods out of fear of future shortages.
sentences.zh: 在經濟危機期間，一些人出於對未來短缺的恐懼，傾向於「囤積」必需品。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to retain or hold back for a particular purpose or future use

sentences.en: The hotel management decided to ______ ten VIP suites for international guests attending the conference.
sentences.zh: 飯店管理層決定為參加會議的國際貴賓「預留（保留）」十間貴賓套房。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to get, acquire, or secure something through effort or request

sentences.en: Researchers must ______ written consent from all participants before conducting medical trial procedures.
sentences.zh: 研究人員在進行醫療試驗程序之前，必須從所有參與者處「獲得（取得）」書面同意。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size

sentences.en: Installing energy-efficient LED light bulbs helped the manufacturing factory ______ its monthly electricity expenses.
sentences.zh: 安裝高能效的 LED 燈泡有助於這家製造廠「降低（減少）」其每月電力開支。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to form an idea of the amount, number, or value of something

sentences.en: Teachers conduct regular assessments to ______ whether students understand key concepts presented in class.
sentences.zh: 教師進行定期測驗，以「評估」學生是否理解課堂上所教授的核心概念。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to establish or decide something conclusively through research or analysis

sentences.en: Laboratory tests were conducted to ______ the exact cause of contamination found in the municipal water supply.
sentences.zh: 進行了實驗室檢測，以「確定」市立供水系統中發現之污染的確切原因。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to buy, obtain, or gain possession of an asset or skill

sentences.en: Through years of diligent practice, the young pianist managed to ______ exceptional technical skill and artistic expression.
sentences.zh: 經過多年的勤奮練習，這位年輕的鋼琴家成功「獲得（學到）」了卓越的技術與藝術表現力。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: very weak, fragile, or slight; uncertain
words.defn_zh: 脆弱的；微弱的；站不住腳的

sentences.en: The agreement rests on a ______ ceasefire that could easily collapse if hostilities resume along the border.
sentences.zh: 該協議建立在「脆弱的（不穩固的）」停火基礎上，如果邊境恢復敵對行動，停火隨時可能崩潰。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: continuing or lasting for a long time; durable

sentences.en: Shakespeare's plays have maintained an ______ popularity across centuries due to their universal human themes.
sentences.zh: 莎士比亞的戲劇因其普世的人性主題，數世紀以來一直保持著「長久的（持久的）」受歡迎程度。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: causing or likely to cause an argument; controversial

sentences.en: Zoning law reform remains a highly ______ issue among residents, dividing local neighborhood association members.
sentences.zh: 分區法改革在居民中依然是一個極具「爭議性的」議題，使當地社區協會成員產生分歧。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: clearly visible or attracting notice or attention

sentences.en: The brightly colored warning sign was placed in a ______ position near the entrance to alert visitors.
sentences.zh: 鮮艷的警告標誌被放置在入口附近一個「顯眼的（顯著的）」位置，以警示訪客。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to form a mental image or concept of something not present

sentences.en: It is difficult to ______ how early navigators crossed vast oceans without modern GPS navigation devices.
sentences.zh: 很難「想像（設想）」早期的航海家在沒有現代 GPS 導航裝置的情況下是如何跨越廣闊海洋的。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to give a brief statement of the main points of something

sentences.en: At the end of the presentation, the speaker took two minutes to ______ the key findings for the audience.
sentences.zh: 在簡報結束時，演講者花了兩分鐘為聽眾「總結（概述）」核心發現。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to conduct a argument in support of something against criticism

sentences.en: The researcher stepped up to ______ her methodology when reviewers questioned the validity of her findings.
sentences.zh: 當審稿人質疑其發現的有效性時，該研究人員挺身而出為她的研究方法進行「辯護（捍衛）」。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to alter or move something slightly to achieve a desired fit or result

sentences.en: Technicians had to ______ the optical lenses carefully to ensure the telescope produced sharp astronomical images.
sentences.zh: 技術人員必須仔細「調整」光學鏡頭，以確保天文望遠鏡能產生清晰的天體影像。

words.section: PART 1: Options & Key Words from Words in Context Questions (Module 1 Q1–5 & Module 2 Q1–5)

words.defn_en: to exceed or go beyond expected limits or records

sentences.en: Company executives were thrilled when fourth-quarter sales figures managed to ______ all financial analyst forecasts.
sentences.zh: 當第四季銷售數字成功「超越（勝過）」所有財務分析師的預測時，公司高主管高興萬分。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to bring about, produce, or cause a specific reaction

sentences.en: Certain food additives are known to ______ allergic reactions in sensitive individuals, prompting warning labels.
sentences.zh: 已知某些食品添加物會在敏感人群中「引起（誘發）」過敏反應，從而引發警告標籤的要求。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: depending on or relating to the surrounding circumstances or context

sentences.en: Understanding historic legal decisions requires analyzing the broader ______ factors surrounding the society at that time.
sentences.zh: 理解歷史性的法律裁決，需要分析當時圍繞著社會的更廣泛「背景（情境）」因素。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: relating to earthquakes or huge earth vibrations

sentences.en: Geologists installed advanced monitoring sensors along the fault line to record minute ______ activity before tremors.
sentences.zh: 地質學家沿斷層線安裝了先進的監測感測器，以記錄震動發生前微小的「地震」活動。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to have a specified beginning or origin; arise

sentences.en: Linguists believe that many technical terms used in modern medicine originally ______ from ancient Greek and Latin.
sentences.zh: 語言學家認為，現代醫學中使用的許多專業術語最初「起源於（來自）」古希臘語和拉丁語。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: molten fluid rock beneath or within the earth's crust

sentences.en: Volcanologists detected rising pressure beneath the volcano, indicating that molten ______ was moving toward the surface crater.
sentences.zh: 火山學家檢測到火山下方壓力上升，表明融化的「岩漿」正移向表面噴發口。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a thing that blocks one's way or prevents progress

sentences.en: Lack of adequate funding remains the primary ______ preventing the non-profit organization from expanding its community clinic.
sentences.zh: 缺乏足夠的資金依然是阻礙該非營利組織擴建其社區診所的主要「障礙」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a person or thing regarded as suitable for a role or experiment

sentences.en: The rare bird species was identified as a prime ______ for captive breeding and reintroduction into protected reserves.
sentences.zh: 這種稀有鳥類被認定為圈養繁殖並重新引入保護區的主要「候選物種（候選對象）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: causing disgust or distaste; repulsive

sentences.en: The pungent chemical odor emitted by the industrial waste was deeply ______ to residents living downwind.
sentences.zh: 工業廢棄物散發出的刺鼻化學氣味，讓居住在下風處的居民感到非常「令人厭惡的（排斥的）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: causing intense disgust or nausea; repulsive
words.defn_zh: 令人作嘔的；極其厭惡的

sentences.en: Inspectors closed the restaurant immediately after finding ______ sanitation conditions in the food preparation kitchen.
sentences.zh: 檢查員在食品準備廚房發現「令人作嘔的（衛生惡劣的）」衛生狀況後，立即勒令該餐廳停業。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to burn slowly with smoke but no flame

sentences.en: Firefighters remained on scene for hours to ensure damp logs did not continue to ______ after the forest fire.
sentences.zh: 消防員在現場留守數小時，以確保森林大火後潮濕的木頭不會繼續「悶燒」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to have a mutual relationship or connection

sentences.en: Medical studies demonstrate that regular physical exercise directly ______s with a reduced risk of cardiovascular disease.
sentences.zh: 醫學研究表明，定期進行體育鍛鍊與降低心血管疾病風險直接「相互關聯（相關）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: opposite in position, direction, order, or effect

sentences.en: There is an ______ relationship between altitude and air pressure: as altitude increases, air pressure decreases noticeably.
sentences.zh: 海拔高度與氣壓之間存在「相反的（反向的）」關係：隨著海拔升高，氣壓明顯下降。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: direct descent from an ancestor; ancestry or pedigree

sentences.en: Genetic testing allowed evolutionary biologists to trace the evolutionary ______ of domestic dogs back to ancient wolves.
sentences.zh: 基因檢測使演化生物學家能夠將家犬的演化「世系（血脈）」追溯至古代狼群。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to put forward as a basis of argument or principle

sentences.en: Philosophers ______ that true ethical decisions must account for the well-being of the entire community, not individuals.
sentences.zh: 哲學家「主張（假定）」，真正的道德決定必須考慮整個社區的福祉，而非個人。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to give or grant someone power or status, or to agree with

sentences.en: The official actions taken by local authorities must ______ with international human rights standards established by treaties.
sentences.zh: 地方當局採取的官方行動必須與條約建立的國際人權標準相「符合（一致）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to deprive a channel or content creator of revenue from ads

sentences.en: Video sharing platforms will ______ content channels that repeatedly violate copyright guidelines by using unlicensed music.
sentences.zh: 影片分享平台將對重複使用未授權音樂而違反著作權指南的內容頻道「取消營利資格」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the state of belonging to the public as a whole, uncovered by copyright

sentences.en: Classic literature published over a century ago enters the ______ ______ , allowing anyone to republish or adapt the works.
sentences.zh: 百年前出版的古典文學作品進入「公有領域」，允許任何人重新出版或改編這些作品。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: fast and energetic in a wild and uncontrolled way

sentences.en: Stock traders worked at a ______ pace on the exchange floor as financial markets experienced sudden price swings.
sentences.zh: 隨著金融市場經歷突如其來的價格波動，股票交易員在交易所大廳以「狂亂的（發狂似的）」節奏工作。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: not feeling or showing emotion; expressionless

sentences.en: Throughout the high-profile court trial, the defendant remained completely ______ while witnesses delivered damaging testimony.
sentences.zh: 在整個備受矚目的法庭審判過程中，當證人發表具破壞性的證詞時，被告全程保持「面無表情（冷漠）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a number of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly fashion

sentences.en: A solemn ceremonial ______ moved slowly down the main avenue during the national holiday parade.
sentences.zh: 在國慶節遊行期間，一列莊嚴的儀式「隊伍（行列）」沿著主幹道緩慢前進。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: surpassing all others; distinguished or supreme

sentences.en: The university appointed a ______ scholar in quantum physics to head its newly established scientific research laboratory.
sentences.zh: 大學任命了一位量子物理學領域「卓越的（傑出的）」學者來領導其新成立的科學研究實驗室。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: done or existing alone; single or isolated

sentences.en: Snow leopards are known to lead a ______ lifestyle, roaming vast mountain ranges alone except during mating season.
sentences.zh: 已知雪豹過著「獨自的（單獨的）」生活型態，除了交配季節外，獨自漫遊於廣袤的山脈。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a short extract from a film, broadcast, or piece of writing

sentences.en: The literature textbook included a brief ______ from the author's famous memoir to illustrate descriptive prose.
sentences.zh: 這本文學教科書包含了作者著名自傳的一段簡短「摘錄」，以說明描寫性散文的風格。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to extinguish a fire by covering it, or suppress feelings

sentences.en: Firefighters used heavy chemical foam to ______ the chemical blaze and prevent oxygen from fueling the flames.
sentences.zh: 消防員使用重型化學泡沫來「悶熄」化學火災，防止氧氣助長火勢。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to represent something as being larger, greater, or worse than it is

sentences.en: Salespeople should never ______ the performance capabilities of a product merely to convince customers to make purchases.
sentences.zh: 銷售人員絕不應該僅為了說服客戶購買，就「誇大」產品的效能表現。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to produce or perform something spontaneously without preparation

sentences.en: When the lead actor forgot his lines on stage, his co-star had to ______ clever dialogue to keep the play moving.
sentences.zh: 當男主角在舞台上忘詞時，他的搭檔不得不「即興創作」聰明的對白，以維持劇目的進行。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to divide into two sharply contrasting groups or sets of opinions

sentences.en: Controversial political issues can easily ______ voters, making bipartisan cooperation extremely difficult in government.
sentences.zh: 具爭議性的政治議題很容易「使（選民）兩極化」，使得政府中的跨黨派合作變得極其困難。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: corresponding in size, degree, or intensity to something else

sentences.en: Tax rates under the proposed system are designed to be ______ to household income levels across social brackets.
sentences.zh: 擬議系統下的稅率旨在與跨社會階層的家庭收入水平「成比例」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a rigid external covering for the body in invertebrates

sentences.en: Insects and crustaceans possess a tough outer ______ that protects their internal organs and provides structural support.
sentences.zh: 昆蟲和甲殼類動物擁有堅硬的外部「外骨骼」，保護其內部器官並提供結構支撐。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: an internal skeleton, such as the bony skeleton of vertebrates

sentences.en: Unlike crabs which shed shells, vertebrates rely on an internal ______ of bone and cartilage that grows with them.
sentences.zh: 與會脫殼的螃蟹不同，脊椎動物依賴隨其生長而增長的骨骼和軟骨組成之內部「內骨骼」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a fictitious name used by an author to conceal identity

sentences.en: The famous novelist chose to publish her detective stories under a ______ to separate them from her serious poetry.
sentences.zh: 這位著名的小說家選擇以「筆名（假名）」出版她的偵探小說，以將其與她的嚴肅詩歌區分開來。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to keep secret or prevent from being seen or known

sentences.en: The fugitive tried to ______ his true identity by using forged passport documents when crossing international borders.
sentences.zh: 該逃犯試圖在跨越國際邊境時使用偽造的護照文件來「隱藏」其真實身份。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to continue to have something; keep possession of

sentences.en: The innovative thermal insulation container is engineered to ______ heat for up to twelve hours in freezing weather.
sentences.zh: 這款創新的隔熱容器經過工程設計，可在寒冷天氣中「保持（保留）」熱量長達十二小時。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to make or become liquid

sentences.en: Extreme industrial heating is required to ______ solid natural gas into liquid form for long-distance tanker transport.
sentences.zh: 需要極端的工業加熱來將固體天然氣「液化」成液態，以便進行長途油輪運輸。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to make or become hard or solid

sentences.en: As melted chocolate cools down at room temperature, it begins to ______ into a smooth solid bar.
sentences.zh: 當融化的巧克力在室溫下冷卻時，它開始「凝固」成光滑的固體塊。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to state one's intention to cause harm, or pose a danger to

sentences.en: Rising sea levels caused by global warming continue to ______ low-lying coastal communities with severe flooding risks.
sentences.zh: 全球暖化引起的海平面上升，持續以嚴重的洪水風險「威脅」著低窪沿海社區。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to put someone or something at risk or in danger

sentences.en: Disposing of untreated toxic chemical waste in rivers can severely ______ marine ecosystems and public health.
sentences.zh: 在河流中處置未經處理的毒性化學廢棄物，會嚴重「危及（使...遭受危險）」海洋生態系統與公眾健康。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a scientist who studies fossils of plants and animals

sentences.en: The renowned ______ spent years excavating fossilized dinosaur bones in the desert badlands of Montana.
sentences.zh: 這位著名的「古生物學家」花了數年時間在蒙大拿州的沙漠荒地挖掘恐龍化石骨骼。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: settling an issue produced a definite result; firm

sentences.en: The general took ______ action during the battle, securing a strategic victory that ended the military conflict.
sentences.zh: 將軍在戰役中採取了「果斷的（決定性的）」行動，確保了終結軍事衝突的戰略勝利。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to become or make more intense or stronger

sentences.en: Authorities warned that wind speeds would ______ overnight as the tropical storm moved closer to the coastline.
sentences.zh: 當熱帶風暴移近海岸線時，當局警告風速將在夜間「加劇（加強）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: existing, happening, or done at the same time

sentences.en: The university hosted two ______ conferences on technology and medicine, drawing international researchers to campus.
sentences.zh: 該大學主辦了兩場「同時發生的」科技與醫學會議，吸引了國際研究人員來到校園。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: relating to politics, especially international relations affected by geography

sentences.en: Fluctuations in global crude oil prices are often heavily influenced by ______ tensions across key oil-producing regions.
sentences.zh: 全球原油價格的波動往往很大程度上受到主要產油區「地緣政治的」緊張局勢影響。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the existing state of affairs, especially regarding social or political issues

sentences.en: Reformers argued that preserving the political ______ ______ would fail to address systemic economic inequality in society.
sentences.zh: 改革派主張，維持政治「現狀」將無法解決社會中系統性的經濟不平等問題。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a religious or solemn ceremony consisting of a series of actions

sentences.en: Anthropologists documented ancient harvest ______s performed by indigenous tribes to express gratitude for crop yields.
sentences.zh: 人類學家記錄了原住民部落為表達對作物產量感激而進行的古代豐收「儀式」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the forming of a theory or conjecture without firm evidence

sentences.en: Media outlets engaged in widespread ______ regarding the potential retirement of the Supreme Court justice.
sentences.zh: 媒體針對最高法院大法官潛在的退休進行了廣泛的「推測（猜想）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a short amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person

sentences.en: The professor began his lecture with a humorous personal ______ to engage students before covering complex physics.
sentences.zh: 教授在講解複雜物理學之前，以一個幽默的個人「軼事（趣聞）」開場以吸引學生。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a person's physical state with regard to health and strength

sentences.en: Despite working long hours outdoors in freezing weather, his rugged physical ______ prevented him from falling ill.
sentences.zh: 儘管在凍人的天氣中於戶外長時間工作，他強健的物理「體質」使他免於生病。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: so small or unimportant as to be not worth considering

sentences.en: The administrative error resulted in a ______ financial loss that had no measurable impact on the company's profits.
sentences.zh: 這項行政錯誤造成了「微不足道的（可忽略的）」財務損失，對公司的利潤沒有產生可測量的影響。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: sternness or severity of manner, or economic spending cuts

sentences.en: Facing a massive national deficit, the government implemented strict ______ measures to reduce public spending.
sentences.zh: 面對巨大的國家赤字，政府實施了嚴格的「緊縮政策（財政緊縮）」以減少公共支出。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the state of being out of place or incompatible

sentences.en: Critics pointed out the obvious ______ between the politician's lavish lifestyle and his public campaign promises.
sentences.zh: 批評家指出了這位政治家奢華的生活方式與其公開競選承諾之間的明顯「不協調（不一致）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to regard something as being caused by a specific agent or factor

sentences.en: Climate scientists ______ recent increases in extreme heatwaves to rising atmospheric greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 氣候科學家將最近極端熱浪的增加「歸因於」大氣溫室氣體排放的上升。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to keep from being seen or concealed; make unclear

sentences.en: Dense morning fog moved across the valley, working to ______ the mountain peaks from the view of hikers below.
sentences.zh: 清晨的濃霧穿過山谷，「遮蔽（使...模糊）」了下方健行者的山峰視野。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: shining or glowing brightly; emitting light
words.defn_zh: 容光煥發的；光芒四射的

sentences.en: The setting sun cast a ______ golden glow across the ocean surface, creating a stunning visual display.
sentences.zh: 落日在大海表面投射出「光芒四射的（金燦燦的）」金色光芒，營造出令人驚嘆的視覺效果。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat

sentences.en: Protecting tropical rainforests is essential for maintaining global ______ , as these ecosystems harbor millions of species.
sentences.zh: 保護熱帶雨林對於維持全球「生物多樣性」至關重要，因為這些生態系統棲息著數以百萬計的物種。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: an attitude of doubt or a disposition to incredulity

sentences.en: Scientific peers greeted the revolutionary cold fusion claims with deep ______ until independent labs reproduced the results.
sentences.zh: 在獨立實驗室重現結果之前，科學界的同僚對這項革命性的冷核融合主張保持著深深的「懷疑態度」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to prepare and use land for crops, or nurture a skill/relationship

sentences.en: Farmers in the region use modern drip irrigation systems to ______ organic vegetables in dry desert climates.
sentences.zh: 該地區的農民使用現代滴灌系統，在乾燥的沙漠氣候中「栽培（耕作）」有機蔬菜。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: relating to an organism that contains genetic material from another species

sentences.en: Biologists conducted controlled studies on ______ crops designed to express pest-resistant genes naturally.
sentences.zh: 生物學家對旨在自然表達抗蟲基因的「基因轉殖的」作物進行了對照研究。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the emission of light by a substance that has absorbed light

sentences.en: Under ultraviolet blacklight, certain ocean jellyfish species exhibit vibrant green ______ due to specialized proteins.
sentences.zh: 在紫外線黑光下，由於特殊的蛋白質，某些海洋水母物種展現出鮮豔的綠色「螢光」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: susceptible to physical or emotional attack or harm

sentences.en: Coastal wildlife species are particularly ______ to oil spills, which destroy protective feathers and contaminate food.
sentences.zh: 沿海野生動物物種特別「易受（油污）傷害」，漏油會破壞牠們的保護性羽毛並污染食物。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: an animal that naturally preys on other animals

sentences.en: The introduction of an invasive ______ into the island habitat rapidly reduced the native lizard population.
sentences.zh: 將外來「捕食者（掠食者）」引入島嶼棲息地，迅速減少了本土蜥蜴的數量。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: originating in human activity; chief regarding environmental pollutants
words.defn_zh: 人為的；由人類活動引起的

sentences.en: Environmental researchers noted that ______ carbon emissions have accelerated ocean warming over the past century.
sentences.zh: 環境研究人員注意到，「人為的（人類活動引起的）」碳排放加速了過去一個世紀的海洋變暖。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the action of depositing material, or a formal statement

sentences.en: Increased atmospheric acid ______ in soil can negatively alter mineral composition and damage tree root systems.
sentences.zh: 土壤中大氣酸性「沉積」的增加，會對礦物質成分產生負面影響並損害樹木根系。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: arranged like rays or the radii of a circle from a central point

sentences.en: Tree core samples showed a decrease in ______ stem growth during years affected by severe summer droughts.
sentences.zh: 樹木核心樣本顯示，在受嚴重夏季乾旱影響的年份裡，樹幹「放射狀的（半徑方向的）」生長有所減少。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to counteract something by having an opposing force or effect

sentences.en: Companies invest in reforestation projects to ______ carbon emissions generated by their industrial factories.
sentences.zh: 公司投資再造林計畫，以「抵消（補償）」其工業工廠產生的碳排放。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the state of having mixed feelings or contradictory ideas
words.defn_zh: 矛盾心理；抱持矛盾態度

sentences.en: The public expressed deep ______ regarding the new urban development project, weighing economic benefits against environmental losses.
sentences.zh: 公眾對這項新的城市開發計畫表達了深深的「矛盾心理」，權衡著經濟利益與環境損失。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the feeling that a person or a thing is beneath consideration or worthless

sentences.en: He showed complete ______ for the established safety rules by operating heavy machinery without wearing protective gear.
sentences.zh: 他在操作重型機械時未穿戴防護裝備，對既定的安全規則展現出完全的「輕視（蔑視）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: imitative of another person's work; unoriginal
words.defn_zh: 派生的；非原創的；模仿的

sentences.en: Art critics dismissed the young painter's exhibition as highly ______ , claiming it lacked original creative vision.
sentences.zh: 藝術批評家認為這位年輕畫家的展覽高度「缺乏原創性（模仿的）」，聲稱其缺乏獨創的藝術視野。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: impossible to understand or comprehend
words.defn_zh: 難以理解的；無法聽懂的

sentences.en: The radio transmission became completely ______ due to heavy static interference during the mountain storm.
sentences.zh: 由於山區暴風雨期間強烈的靜電干擾，無線電傳輸變得完全「難以理解（無法聽清）」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a body of permeable rock that can contain or transmit groundwater

sentences.en: Agricultural irrigation in the arid valley depends entirely on pumping water from a deep underground ______ .
sentences.zh: 乾旱山谷中的農業灌溉完全依賴從深層地下「含水層」抽水。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the supply of water to land or crops to help growth

sentences.en: Modern agricultural techniques utilize automated drip ______ to conserve water while maximizing crop yields.
sentences.zh: 現代農業技術利用自動化滴頭「灌溉」，在節約用水的同時實現作物產量最大化。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a minimum or starting point used for comparisons

sentences.en: Researchers established a pre-treatment ______ measurement to track future changes in patient blood pressure accurately.
sentences.zh: 研究人員建立了治療前的「基準」測量值，以精確追蹤未來患者血壓的變化。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a particular form of a language peculiar to a specific region

sentences.en: Linguists traveled to remote mountain villages to record native speakers using an endangered regional ______ .
sentences.zh: 語言學家前往偏遠的山區村莊，記錄母語人士使用一種面臨消亡的區域「方言」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to send settlers to a place and establish political control over it

sentences.en: Historical records indicate that European powers attempted to ______ territories across multiple continents during the 17th century.
sentences.zh: 歷史記錄表明，歐洲強權在 17 世紀企圖在多個大洲「殖民（開拓）」領土。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: an implement, container, or vessel used for household or kitchen use

sentences.en: Stainless steel kitchen ______s are preferred in commercial food preparation due to their durability and ease of cleaning.
sentences.zh: 不鏽鋼廚房「器具（餐具）」因其耐用性和易清潔性，在商業食品準備中備受青睞。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to express complete disapproval of; censure officially

sentences.en: International human rights organizations issued a joint statement to ______ the military government's violent crackdowns.
sentences.zh: 國際人權組織發表聯合聲明，公開「譴責」軍政府的暴力鎮壓。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to make into fiction; give a fictional version of real events

sentences.en: The screenwriter decided to ______ historical events surrounding the 1920 gold rush to create a compelling movie script.
sentences.zh: 編劇決定將圍繞 1920 年淘金熱的歷史事件「小說化（虛構化）」，以創作吸引人的電影劇本。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to cause widespread damage, destruction, or chaos

sentences.en: Unusually strong hurricane winds threatened to ______ ______ on coastal infrastructure and electrical power grids.
sentences.zh: 異常強烈的颶風威脅著要「對...造成嚴重破壞」沿海基礎設施與電力網。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to remove or force out from a position or place

sentences.en: Rescue teams used heavy hydraulic equipment to ______ large granite boulders blocking the mountain highway.
sentences.zh: 救援隊使用重型液壓設備來「驅逐（移位）」堵塞山區公路的大型花崗岩巨石。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: nothing other than; unmitigated or absolute size/magnitude

sentences.en: The container ship was delayed for days in the narrow canal due to its ______ physical size and heavy cargo load.
sentences.zh: 貨櫃輪因其「純粹的（龐大的）」物理尺寸和沉重的貨物負載，在狹窄的運河中延誤了數天。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities

sentences.en: The celebrated actor is remarkably ______ , performing effortlessly in Shakespearean tragedies, comedy films, and musicals.
sentences.zh: 這位著名的演員非常「多才多藝的」，在莎士比亞悲劇、喜劇電影和音樂劇中都能游刃有餘地演出。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to make attitudes or behavior part of one's nature by learning

sentences.en: Children gradually ______ cultural values and social etiquette through daily interactions with parents and teachers.
sentences.zh: 兒童透過與父母和老師的日常互動，逐漸將文化價值觀和社會禮儀「內化」。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to be the cause or basis of something; exist beneath
words.defn_zh: 成為...的基礎；部位於...之下

sentences.en: Psychologists study how deep-seated internal beliefs ______ emotional reactions and behavioral choices in stressful moments.
sentences.zh: 心理學家研究深層的內部信念如何「成為...的基礎（構成基礎）」在壓力時刻的情感反應和行為選擇。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a large-scale art structure created for a specific space

sentences.en: The museum commissioned a massive contemporary steel ______ that transformed the outdoor sculpture garden.
sentences.zh: 博物館委託製作了一個大型現代鋼鐵「裝置藝術」，改變了戶外雕塑花園的面貌。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: a scientist who specializes in the science of measurement

sentences.en: A team of expert ______s at the international standards institute worked to define the kilogram using atomic constants.
sentences.zh: 國際標準研究所的專業「計量學家」團隊致力於利用原子常數來定義公斤。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: the point on which a lever rests or turns

sentences.en: In a first-class lever, the ______ is positioned directly between the applied effort force and the load object.
sentences.zh: 在第一類槓桿中，「支點」直接部位於施加的施力與重物負載之間。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to turn or balance on or as if on a fulcrum

sentences.en: Mechanical levers are designed to ______ smoothly around a fixed central point to lift heavy construction loads.
sentences.zh: 機械槓桿設計為圍繞固定中心點平穩地「樞軸轉動」，以抬起沉重的建築負載。

words.section: PART 2: Additional Advanced Academic, Literary & Scientific Vocabulary Across Modules 1 & 2

words.defn_en: to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way; thrive

sentences.en: Spanish-language journalism began to ______ across Texas cities in the late 19th century due to growing immigrant communities.
sentences.zh: 19 世紀末，由於移民社區的增長，西班牙語新聞業開始在德州各城市「繁榮發展（茁壯成長）」。
